info.title: migrate-mongo
info.description: The migrate-mongo command line tool for Kevsoft.MigrateMongo: create, apply and roll back MongoDB migrations written in C#. Works with any .NET runtime (10+) and any supported MongoDB driver version because your migrations run in your own project.

commands.name: baseline
commands.description: Record migrations as applied without running them.

options.name: --to
options.description: Record every migration up to and including this id as applied.

options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --file

options.description: Environment from the config file to use.

options.name: --json
options.description: Write machine-readable JSON lines instead of text.

options.name: --insecure-skip-host-key-check
options.description: Don't verify the SSH tunnel server's host key (not recommended).

options.name: --runner
options.description: Run a pre-built runner (a .dll or a bundle executable) instead of building the project.

commands.name: plan
commands.description: Show what 'up' would do. Exits with code 2 if there is pending work.

options.name: --only
options.description: Only apply migrations, or only collection definitions (default: both).

options.name: --allow-rebuild
options.description: Let this index (collection.index) be dropped and created again even when onRebuild is fail. Repeat for more.

options.name: --allow-unmatched
options.description: Change this collection even though none of its existing indexes match the declared ones. Repeat for more.

options.name: --allow-superseded
options.description: Apply collection definitions that a newer run has already replaced (e.g. when rolling back on purpose).
